manifest: E5 growth/staging closure-currency INPUT manifest — E5-minimal-physical-v2 (3-family available-data decisive certificate). LOCKED before WP-E5-CODE build.
design_label: E5-minimal-physical-v3A: 3-family ALL-3-of-3 SCALE-CUT-decisive certificate. Decisive staging axis = scale_cut (the unique axis non-vacuous + legal for all 3 families per the G-E5-NONVAC pre-mortem; external reviewer approved 2026-06-01). HSC photo-z = diagnostic/nonvacuity_fail (does NOT count). redshift-tomographic = secondary diagnostic. baryon = Omega_theory/method-control only. NOT a full 3x2pt promotion. Tests a SCALE-STAGING closure currency (not all-axis).
manifest_note: Freezes EVERY probe, fold, staging axis, nuisance model, and Omega input BEFORE the build. WP-E5-CODE MUST read + sha256-stamp this file and may use ONLY what is listed here. Validated by tests/test_e5_manifest.py. Governs with plan/E5_CARRIER_REALIZATION.md and plan/E5_DESIGN_FREEZE.md.

conditions_locked: C1: 4-fold LOFO -> 3-fold LOFO (DES Y6 dropped: no buildable official vector/covariance).
C2: G-E5-CURRENCY-DECISIVE -> ALL-3-of-3 (not >=2-of-3). Prefer false negatives over false positives; E5 is the sole decisive front after R0.
C3: add KiDS<->HSC shared-systematics floor Omega_WL_shared to Omega_nuisance_systematics + a pre-registered conservative shared-WL correlation stress.
C4: DES Y3 = method-control / pipeline-rehearsal ONLY, NEVER decisive, NEVER a fold.
C5: HSC Fourier C_ell + DESI-recal n(z) is valid, but the Fourier/real-space pipeline mismatch must be controlled or budgeted (Omega_HSC_pipeline).

decisive_requirement: G-E5-CURRENCY-DECISIVE-3FAM requires ALL 3 independent growth families (KiDS-Legacy shear-cal, HSC-Y3 photo-z, ACT+SPT+Planck CMB-lensing) to pass their held-out LOFO fold; judged on staging localization (NOT a scalar S8 shift).
split_discipline: ROTATING leave-one-family-out (LOFO). The 3 decisive growth families form 3 folds; in each fold ONE family is the held-out WITNESS and the other 2 are the DECLARE/BUILD set (they fix L_geom, C, Omega, the staging grids, the certificate). lambda_max(Xi_C - Omega) is evaluated on the held-out witness family ONLY. Omega is re-frozen per fold on that fold's declare set, pre-witness. RSD and DES Y3 are method-controls (never decisive, never a fold).

probes.data_vector: UNAVAILABLE — no official executable DES Y6 3x2pt data vector + covariance released (Jan 2026 paper only). Scientifically the ideal low-z 3x2pt substrate; excluded from the buildable certificate until an official vector/covariance product exists.
probes.staging_role: ideal prime low-z 3x2pt substrate (NOT exercised in v2)

PIPELINE REHEARSAL / METHOD-CONTROL ONLY (reviewer C4, 2026-06-01): NEVER decisive, NEVER a fold. A DES-Y3-inclusive 4-family alternative, if ever desired, must be a SEPARATE pre-registered auxiliary analysis defined before looking at E5 outcomes.
independent shear-calibration / redshift-calibration contrast (COSEBIs E-mode, modes 1-6). NOT 'low S8 evidence'.

staging_pair.contrast: ORIGINAL HSC n(z) vs DESI-DR1/2-recalibrated n(z), SAME Fourier C_ell data vector+cov, propagated per tomographic bin.

probes.staging_role: SCALE-CUT decisive (high-ell increments); photo-z is DIAGNOSTIC-only (absorbed by HSC dz); redshift secondary.

probes.source_arxiv: ACT DR6 + SPT-3G + Planck PR4 joint lensing (LAMBDA act_spt_joint)
probes.staging_role: SCALE-CUT decisive (high-L increments); MODEST eligibility (post 2.8-5.5), single-axis fold.

probes.rsd_status: method-control ONLY; DESI DR2 has no public fsigma8 product.

decisive_rule: G-E5-CURRENCY-DECISIVE-v3A passes iff: (1) G-E5-NONVAC(scale_cut) passes for KiDS, HSC, AND CMB-lensing (eligibility only); (2) the KiDS-heldout, HSC-heldout, and CMB-lensing-heldout LOFO folds EACH pass G-E5-PSD AND G-E5-STAGING AND G-E5-HETERO AND G-E5-ZERO (ALL-3-of-3, NO >=2-of-3 rescue); (3) G-E5-STAGING evaluated on the PRE-REGISTERED scale-cut ordering (KiDS high COSEBIs modes; HSC high-ell; CMB high-L); (4) reversed/randomized scale-cut-order AND shuffled-stage-label zero controls both below budget; (5) Omega includes Omega_WL_shared and survives the conservative KiDS<->HSC shared-systematics stress (rho_KH in {0.25,0.5,0.75}); (6) Omega_HSC_pipeline included for the HSC Fourier/real-space mismatch; (7) the baryon/nonlinear proxy is NOT a decisive axis; (8) G-ENV-4, G-E5-BACKEND, G-E5-REPRO, G-E5-NOSURR, G-E5-COV, G-E5-RANK, G-E5-KERNEL, G-E5-SYS all pass. Any scientific fold fail => ACCEPTED_NEGATIVE/non-promoted; data/backend/kernel fail => BLOCKED.

staging_axes.grid: LOCKED E5-v3 grid: HSC/CMB nested ell_max/L_max in {1000,1500,2000,3000,5000}; KiDS nested COSEBIs modes {1-3,1-4,1-5,1-6}. Adjacent-cut perturbations are theta(cut_upper)-theta(cut_lower), zero outside newly admitted scale rows.

staging_axes.var: low-z vs high-z bins; drop-lowest / drop-highest
staging_axes.grid: per-probe tomographic drop sequence (HSC 4 bins, KiDS 6 bins, CMB-lensing L-as-z proxy)

staging_axes.var: Halofit vs HMCode; baryon-feedback amplitude; k_max
NLA vs TATT; IA prior width

scale_cut_grid.construction: For NONVAC and G-E5-STAGING use adjacent nested-cut perturbations theta(cut_upper)-theta(cut_lower), represented in the native full data vector with zeros outside newly admitted rows. Do not use signed whole-vector contrasts.

forbidden_staging_axis: survey_label (a confounder; G-E5-HETERO requires correlation with an INDEPENDENT heterogeneity proxy, not survey labels)

nuisance_model.priors: published per-survey priors (KiDS Wright+25, HSC Dalal+23, ACT/SPT/Planck lensing)
nuisance_model.high_correlation_stress_variant: REQUIRED for photo_z, shear_calibration, common theory error, AND the KiDS<->HSC shared-WL correlation (do NOT default cross-survey covariance to zero)

omega_budget.policy: Omega = max(Omega_same_family, Omega_synthetic_null, Omega_nuisance_systematics, Omega_theory) + Delta_margin
omega_budget.computed_on: declare_build split ONLY, before the witness split is evaluated
omega_budget.Omega_same_family: null residual from rows already explainable by L_geom (same-family saturation)
omega_budget.Omega_nuisance_systematics: IA + baryon + photo-z + shear-cal + redshift-cal + covariance-uncertainty propagated through the Schur pipeline, INCLUDING Omega_WL_shared

Omega_WL_shared.desc: KiDS<->HSC shared cosmic-shear systematics floor (reviewer C3): IA model, baryon/nonlinear-power, photo-z calibration, shear calibration, common theory/covariance approximation.
Omega_WL_shared.rule: the all-3-of-3 headline MUST survive the BASELINE shared-systematics model AND at least one CONSERVATIVE high-correlation stress (rho_KH^sys in {0.25,0.50,0.75}). If the signal only passes under diagonal KiDS/HSC independence, it is NOT decisive.

Omega_HSC_pipeline.desc: HSC Fourier-vs-real-space pipeline-mismatch floor (reviewer C5): the original-vs-recal n(z) contrast is applied through the HSC Fourier C_ell pipeline; budget the Fourier/real-space discrepancy.
Omega_HSC_pipeline.rule: the HSC fold is decisive only if the n(z) contrast is propagated through the HSC Fourier pipeline with a declared Omega_HSC_pipeline floor AND either a real-space Li+23 method-control agrees qualitatively OR the Fourier/real-space mismatch is explicitly budgeted. If Fourier and real-space controls disagree in sign/localization/staging, downgrade the HSC fold to diagnostic => all-3-of-3 fails.

omega_budget.Omega_theory: pyccl<->CLASS mismatch + nonlinear-power-prescription spread + Gaussian-compressed-likelihood approximation floor
omega_budget.Delta_margin: declared per fold on the declare set, pre-witness (>=0)
omega_budget.frozen: provenance-stamped + sha256-frozen before unblinding; NEVER tuned on the witness split

localization_threshold.rule: PASS G-E5-STAGING iff (m_high(v_max) >= 0.60 AND m_high >= 2x median shuffled-stage null) OR (Spearman |rho| >= 0.6 with bootstrap CI excluding 0)

zero_controls: (1) same-family saturation: D_growth replaced by rows already explained by L_geom -> below budget
(4) linear / zero-heterogeneity synthetic control -> below budget
(5) held-out survey's staging vector removed from BOTH L and D -> below budget
DPI/coarsening guard: coarsening native probes must NOT artificially increase the audit

excluded.item: DES Y6 3x2pt as a decisive family in v2
excluded.reason: no official executable data vector + covariance released (Jan 2026 paper only); ideal but not buildable.
reviewer C2: with 3 families a 2-of-3 could pass on the two correlated cosmic-shear legs alone; use ALL-3-of-3.
reviewer C4: rehearsal/method-control ONLY; a DES-Y3 4-family alternative must be a separate pre-registered auxiliary analysis.

excluded.item: scalar S8-shift as the decisive observable
excluded.reason: primary observable is the sign-free lambda_max(Xi_C - Omega); S8 tension softened 2025-26.

excluded.item: fitted per-probe Xi_p / signed closure amplitudes
excluded.reason: Xi_C is COMPUTED from locked (L_geom,D_growth,C), not shaped (G-E5-RANK).

excluded.item: DESI DR2 fsigma8 as decisive without a manifest-verified public product

decisive_axis_note: G-E5-NONVAC(scale_cut) is an ELIGIBILITY gate ONLY -- it cannot contribute directly to G-E5-CURRENCY-DECISIVE except by allowing the family/axis to be tested. The decisive claim requires G-E5-PSD AND G-E5-STAGING AND G-E5-HETERO AND G-E5-ZERO on the pre-registered scale-cut ordering across all 3 LOFO folds. High ||t||_post (S/N) alone is NOT a detection.

scale_cut.CMB_lensing: PASS (post 2.8-5.5 on L increments; MODEST, single-axis fold -> do not relax STAGING/ZERO)
